Quick reference

Course glossary

Acceptance

Formal confirmation that deliverables meet requirements.

Accessibility

Design usable by people with varied abilities.

Action owner

Person accountable for execution.

Adjustment

Including variables to compare conditional relationships.

Analysis plan

Planned methods and outputs for each question.

Analytical method

Technique used to answer a question.

Analytical question

Specific question answerable with data.

Annotation

Text or mark explaining important context.

Anomaly

Unexpected pattern or observation.

Appendix

Supporting technical detail.

Artifact

File or output demonstrating work.

Association

Observed relationship between variables.

Assumption

Unverified belief used temporarily.

Audit trail

Evidence of actions and decisions.

Authorization

Permission to access or use data.

Backtest

Historical simulation of forecasting performance.

Baseline

Reference value for comparison.

Baseline forecast

Simple reference model used for comparison.

Business significance

Practical value of a result.

CTE

Named query expression used within a statement.

Call to action

Explicit requested decision or next step.

Cardinality

Number of distinct values.

Case study

Structured narrative of a completed project.

Causality

Claim that changing one factor changes another.

Challenge

Deliberate test of assumptions and logic.

Change log

Chronological record of modifications.

Charter

Short document authorizing and defining the work.

Checkpoint

Formal review before the next stage.

Coefficient

Estimated change associated with a predictor.

Comparable period

Period with a fair basis for comparison.

Comparison

Reference used to interpret a result.

Confidence interval

Range produced by a repeated-sampling procedure.

Confounder

Variable related to both exposure and outcome.

Constraint

Limit on time, data, budget, policy, or action.

Contingency

Alternative response if assumptions fail.

Control

Reference condition.

Control check

Formula or rule verifying workbook integrity.

Control total

Expected aggregate used for validation.

Correlation

Standardized measure of linear or ranked association.

Coverage

Extent to which the source includes the target population.

Coverage period

Dates represented in the dataset.

Cross-tool agreement

Consistent result under the same definition.

DAX measure

Context-sensitive calculation.

Data dictionary

Documentation of fields and their meaning.

Data owner

Person accountable for a data asset.

Decision

Action or choice the analysis is intended to support.

Decision context

Circumstances in which the result will be used.

Decision threshold

Rule that triggers an action.

Denominator

Base count used in a rate or percentage.

Dependency

External input or action required for progress.

Distribution

Pattern of values across a range.

Domain

Allowed set of values for a field.

Drill-down

Moving from summary to detailed level.

Drillthrough

Navigation from summary to relevant detail.

Driver

Factor that influences an outcome metric.

Duplicate

Repeated record or event beyond the intended grain.

Effect size

Magnitude of a difference or relationship.

Entity

Real-world thing represented by data.

Environment

Defined interpreter and package set.

Estimate

Value calculated from observed data.

Event annotation

Recorded occurrence that may explain a change.

Evidence

Validated output used to support a conclusion.

Evidence link

Path from a claim to its supporting output.

Evidence map

Link between claims and supporting calculations.

Evidence review

Assessment of current findings and support.

Excel Table

Structured range with managed references.

Exception

Record that fails a quality rule.

Executive summary

Concise decision-focused overview.

Expected value

Probability-weighted benefit or cost.

Filter parity

Use of equivalent filters across tools.

Finding

Recorded issue or improvement opportunity.

Fitness for use

Suitability for a defined analytical purpose.

Forecast horizon

Time between prediction and outcome.

Foreign key

Field connecting to another table.

Function

Reusable block of code.

Go/no-go decision

Decision to continue, revise, or stop.

Grain

Level represented by one row or observation.

Guardrail metric

Measure protecting against harmful side effects.

Handoff

Transfer of an asset and its supporting context.

Handoff note

Instructions for using and maintaining the output.

Handoff risk

Risk that others cannot operate or verify the solution.

Holdout period

Data reserved for evaluation.

Hypothesis

Testable proposed explanation.

Implication

Why the finding matters.

In scope

Work explicitly included.

Influence

Degree to which a record changes a result.

Information hierarchy

Order that guides attention and understanding.

Insight log

Record of findings, evidence, and status.

Interpretation

Meaning assigned in context.

Invalid value

Value outside an allowed rule or domain.

Iteration

Returning to an earlier stage after learning something new.

Join

Operation that combines related rows.

KPI

Key performance indicator tied to an objective.

Known issue

Documented unresolved limitation.

Lineage

Trace of data from source through transformations.

Maintainability

Ease of reviewing and updating work.

Mapping table

Approved correspondence between raw and standard values.

Metric dictionary

Controlled definitions for calculations and filters.

Metric note

Definition or caveat attached to a measure.

Minimization

Limiting data to what is necessary.

Missing value

Expected value that is absent.

Missingness

Pattern and amount of absent values.

Mix effect

Change caused by different composition of groups.

Model specification

Chosen functional form and variables.

Monitoring metric

Measure used after action.

Notebook

Executable document combining code and narrative.

Null hypothesis

Reference claim evaluated by a test.

Observation

What the analysis directly shows.

One-to-many

Relationship where one key matches multiple rows.

Out of scope

Work intentionally excluded.

Outlier

Observation unusually distant from others.

Peer review

Evaluation by another qualified person.

Personal data

Information relating to an identifiable person.

PivotTable

Interactive grouped summary.

Population

Full group the conclusion concerns.

Precision

Narrowness or stability of an estimate.

Primary key

Field or fields uniquely identifying a row.

Priority

Relative urgency and value.

Problem statement

Concise description of the situation and consequence.

Processed layer

Data prepared for analysis.

Profile

Structured summary of a dataset.

Quality assurance

Planned activities that prevent defects.

Quality dimension

Aspect such as completeness or validity.

Quantile

Cut point dividing ordered data.

Query grain

Level returned by each result row.

README

Repository landing document explaining purpose and use.

Randomization

Chance-based assignment to groups.

Range check

Test against plausible minimum and maximum values.

Raw layer

Preserved source data.

Recommendation

Proposed action based on evidence and constraints.

Reconciliation

Comparison proving totals and counts remain explainable.

Reconciliation query

Query that validates counts or totals.

Reflection

What the analyst learned and would improve.

Refresh

Process that updates data.

Refresh instruction

Procedure for updating the dataset.

Refresh path

Steps for updating inputs and outputs.

Regression check

Test that an update did not break prior results.

Release

Named stable state of a project.

Remediation

Action taken to correct or manage a defect.

Report interaction

Filtering or navigation behavior between visuals.

Reproducible run

Execution from clean state with consistent output.

Residual

Observed value minus fitted value.

Resolution

Documented response to a review finding.

Retention

Period for keeping data and outputs.

Risk

Uncertain event that can affect the outcome.

Robust statistic

Measure less sensitive to extreme values.

Row grain

Business meaning of one row.

Sample

Observed subset used in analysis.

Scalability

Ability to handle growth in data or use.

Scope

Boundaries of the work.

Scope change

Approved alteration to project boundaries.

Seasonality

Pattern repeating at a regular interval.

Segment

Defined subgroup of observations.

Selection bias

Systematic difference caused by selection.

Semantic meaning

Business interpretation attached to data.

Semantic model

Business-ready model used by reports.

Sensitivity analysis

Comparing results under alternative treatments.

Sign-off

Recorded approval by a responsible reviewer.

Skewness

Asymmetry of a distribution.

Small-base warning

Caution when a rate uses few observations.

Source system

Originating application or record system.

Sponsor

Person accountable for the project outcome.

Stakeholder

Person or group that uses or is affected by the work.

Standard error

Estimated variability of an estimator.

Standardization

Applying a consistent representation.

Star schema

Fact table connected to dimensions.

Statistical power

Probability of detecting a specified effect.

Success criterion

Observable condition for acceptable completion.

Summary page

High-level view of outcomes and decisions.

Summary statistic

Number describing a feature of data.

Target quantity

Metric or relationship the analysis estimates.

Technical depth

Level of implementation detail.

Threshold

Acceptable limit for a test.

Tolerance

Allowed numerical difference.

Tool fit

Suitability of a tool for the task.

Trade-off

Balance between competing objectives or risks.

Transformation

Rule that changes data form or value.

Treatment

Documented response to a data issue.

Trend

Longer-term direction of a series.

Triangulation

Checking a finding with multiple sources or methods.

Type conversion

Changing data representation intentionally.

Unit

Measurement scale such as BDT, days, or percent.

Unit conversion

Expressing measures in a common unit.

Unmatched record

Row without a corresponding key.

Validation

Evidence that an output meets requirements.

Version control

System for recording changes over time.

View

Saved query exposed as a virtual table.

Visual encoding

Use of position, length, color, or shape to represent data.

Walkthrough

Guided explanation of a project.

Winsorization

Capping values at chosen limits.

Workbook architecture

Planned organization of sheets and logic.

Workflow

Ordered but iterative project stages.

p-value

Probability of a result at least as extreme under the null model.
